offers.title: VFX Artist
offers.description: We’re looking for talented VFX Artists to join the Eleons team! We’re looking for artists who can bring abilities, attacks, and visual effects to life with high-quality, polished visuals that fit our game’s art style. Requirements Strong Drawing & Sketching Skills — Ability to sketch out VFX concepts or provide clear visual references and ideas for how an effect should look. Creative Visualization — Ability to communicate your ideas through sketches, references, or rough concepts before moving into production. Custom Asset Creation — Ability to create your own assets for VFX rather than relying entirely on pre-made assets. Texturing Skills — Experience creating custom textures for effects, including the ability to design and produce textures from scratch. Strong Artistic Eye — Understanding of color, shape, lighting, timing, and visual impact to create appealing and readable effects. What We’re Looking For We’re looking for people who can take an idea from concept to execution. You should be able to visualize an effect, sketch or communicate the concept, create the necessary assets and textures, and turn it into a polished VFX effect in-game. When applying, please include: Your portfolio or previous VFX work. Examples of your sketches or VFX concepts, if available. Examples of custom assets and textures you’ve created. A brief description of the tools you use and your experience. Softwares you should be familiar with Adobe Animate, Blender, Illugen, Houdini, Embergen, Pixel Composer, Photoshop/Krita Please only apply if you have relevant work to showcase. We’re looking for artists who can demonstrate both creativity and technical ability.

offers.title: Senior VFX Artist (Stylized Games | Unity3D) Europe
offers.description: Senior VFX Artist (Stylized Games | Unity3D) Location: Remote | International Team Employment: Full-Time / Long-Term Position Overview We are looking for an experienced Senior VFX Artist with exceptional artistic taste and a passion for creating expressive, impactful, and visually memorable real-time effects for game development. We believe great VFX goes beyond visual spectacle. Every effect should communicate gameplay intent, reinforce the artistic direction, and make the player's experience feel more responsive, exciting, and rewarding. From subtle environmental effects to powerful combat abilities, we want VFX that combine exceptional artistic quality with strong gameplay readability, personality, and technical efficiency. As part of our co-development team, you will collaborate closely with VFX Leads, Art Directors, Game Designers, and Technical Artists to create and polish high-quality effects directly in-engine. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who combines strong visual instincts with practical real-time VFX production experience. Key Responsibilities Stylized VFX Creation Create high-quality stylized real-time VFX for gameplay, combat, abilities, characters, and environments. Develop visually distinctive effects with strong shape language, color, timing, composition, and artistic consistency. Create compelling effects that communicate power, emotion, impact, and gameplay intent. Work with particle systems, shaders, textures, flipbooks, meshes, and other real-time VFX techniques. Maintain a cohesive visual language across different effects and gameplay features. Gameplay Readability & Artistic Quality Ensure effects communicate clear gameplay information without overwhelming the player. Establish strong visual hierarchy across anticipation, impact, follow-through, and recovery. Balance expressive visual effects with responsiveness and gameplay clarity. Refine timing, motion, color, and composition to achieve satisfying gameplay feedback. Iterate directly in-engine to evaluate effects in real gameplay situations. Technical Implementation & Optimization Create and implement real-time VFX in Unity3D or comparable game engines. Optimize particle counts, overdraw, shaders, textures, and other performance-sensitive elements. Work with Technical Artists and Engineers to solve implementation and rendering challenges. Develop reusable VFX assets, templates, and production-friendly workflows. Ensure effects meet quality and performance requirements across target platforms. Collaboration & Ownership Collaborate with Art Directors, Game Designers, Animators, Technical Artists, and Engineers. Translate creative direction and gameplay requirements into compelling visual effects. Participate in VFX reviews and contribute to artistic quality standards. Provide constructive feedback and support other VFX artists when needed. Take ownership of assigned effects from early concept through final implementation and polish. Proactively identify opportunities to elevate visual quality and gameplay feedback. Requirements 5+ years of professional experience as a real-time VFX Artist in game development. Experience contributing to commercially released game productions. Exceptional portfolio or VFX reel demonstrating strong artistic quality and polished in-game effects. Strong experience creating stylized VFX with appealing timing, motion, shape language, and color. Excellent understanding of composition, visual hierarchy, animation principles, and gameplay readability. Proficiency with Unity3D particle systems, shaders, materials, and real-time VFX workflows, or comparable experience with other game engines. Experience with texture creation, flipbooks, mesh particles, trails, and shader-driven effects. Strong understanding of real-time rendering and VFX performance optimization. Ability to independently develop effects from initial exploration through final in-engine implementation. Strong artistic judgment, attention to detail, and creative problem-solving skills. Excellent communication skills and fluency in English. Bonus Skills Experience with stylized mobile games. Strong skills in Shader Graph, HLSL, or custom shader development. Experience with Houdini, EmberGen, or other VFX content creation tools. Familiarity with pixel-inspired, simplified, or highly stylized visual aesthetics. Experience creating expressive combat, ability, and character-driven VFX. Knowledge of mobile GPU optimization and performance-constrained

offers.title: VFX Artist
offers.description:
Join our team of like-minded people passionate about a common goal and love for games as a VFX Artist! RESPONSIBILITIES Create high-quality real-time VFX in different art styles for combat, environments, destruction, weather, and UI. Integrate, test, profile, and optimize effects for the target engine and platform. Solve creative and technical issues while collaborating with art, design, animation, and engineering teams. QUALIFICATIONS 3+ years of industry experience and a portfolio demonstrating real-time VFX in a released game or game engine. Hands-on experience with Niagara, Unity VFX Graph, or comparable particle systems. Ability to create effects independently from reference and concept through in-engine integration and polish. Strong knowledge of real-time rendering, materials and shaders, lighting, PBR, flipbooks, masks, UV distortion, decals, and vertex animation. Proficiency in creating VFX textures, meshes, and simple animations using 3D and texturing software. Strong artistic fundamentals, including composition, form, silhouette, color, light, timing, anticipation, impact, readability, and visual hierarchy. Ability to adapt effects to gameplay, camera distance, environment, lighting, and a broad range of art styles. Practical optimization and profiling knowledge, including overdraw, shader complexity, particle count, draw calls, memory, LODs, and scalability. Understanding of production pipelines, version control, naming conventions, asset structure, and task tracking. English level B1+ Will be a plus Working knowledge of dynamics and simulation tools such as Houdini. Scripting experience for pipeline or workflow automation. Strong animation principles and an interest in both technical and artistic problem-solving. We always welcome new, talented professionals, so we look forward to receiving a CV with a link to your portfolio! ABOUT US Founded in 2004, Virtuos is one of the largest independent video game development companies. We are headquartered in Singapore with offices in Asia, Europe, and North America. Specializing in full-cycle game development and art production, we have delivered high-quality content for more than 1,500 console, PC, and mobile games. Our clients include 23 of the top 25 gaming companies worldwide. About Our Team Volmi - A Virtuos Studio is an outsourcing company that specializes in game development and game content creation. Over the past 9 years, we have successfully completed over a thousand different projects and have gained considerable experience in creating 2D and 3D art, as well as developing turnkey games. Since 2022, we have been a part of Virtuos, the world's leading game developer, and have become the first Virtuos studio in Eastern Europe.

offers.description: Lakshya, a Keywords Studios company, in India is headquartered in Gurgaon and has a team of over 700 employees spread across studio facilities in Gurgaon, Pune and Seattle, and sales offices in San Diego and Tokyo. Setup in 2004, Lakshya has, over the last 20 years, created a reputation in the game development industry for being a highly talented and dependable game art studio. During this time, Lakshya has created art for over a hundred game titles, including hugely successful global hits such as Bloodborne, Dark Souls II, Just Cause 3, WWE 2K16, Uncharted 2, Farmville and Cityville. Lakshya’s senior team, which comprises of top-notch International and Indian talent, has a huge amount of experience of creating art for different game platforms and genres. Lakshya blends artistic creativity with strong process orientation in order to deliver best in class services. Lakshya works closely with NASSCOM to help in the growth of the game development eco-system in India. For more info, please refer to https://lakshyadigital.com/ About the Role: We are seeking a Senior VFX Artist to help lead the creation of high-impact real-time effects. In this role, you will create and implement VFX that bring Legends, weapons, and seasonal moments to life — reporting to the Lead VFX Artist and collaborating closely with Art, Design, Animation, and Engineering to raise the visual quality bar across the game. We are looking for someone with a passion for visceral, intense combat and a deep understanding of how VFX can drive player intensity, readability, and emotional impact in a fight. 5+ years of professional experience as a real-time VFX artist in the games or film industry. Strong portfolio of shipped in-game real-time VFX work; portfolio examples that showcase bombastic, gritty combat and VFX-driven player intensity are a strong plus. Proficiency with relevant DCC tools such as Maya, Houdini, Photoshop, or Substance Designer, and experience implementing your own work within a game engine or proprietary toolset. Experience mentoring, reviewing work, or helping guide other artists, with strong communication and collaboration skills across disciplines. Passion for making and playing games. Experience creating VFX for visceral, intense combat games is a plus. Experience with first-person games, sci-fi art direction, or live-service seasonal content is a plus. Shipped AAA game credit is a plus. Responsibilities: Create and implement high-quality real-time VFX for abilities, weapons, seasonal content, and gameplay moments — with a focus on delivering effects that feel visceral, impactful, and true to the intensity of combat. Help define and maintain the visual quality bar for VFX across seasonal updates, weapon releases, character abilities, and gameplay moments. VFX problem-solving for complex content, including visual polish, performance constraints, and technical issues across the content pipeline. Collaborate closely with Art, Design, Animation, and Engineering to develop effects that support gameplay, improve clarity, and strengthen the visual identity of Apex Legends. Helping raise the quality and consistency of the team’s work. Contribute to visual direction and help evolve real-time VFX language, supporting production planning to ensure work is scoped and delivered effectively. We offer the opportunity to work on some of the best-known game titles in the world. We offer competitive salaries and annual performance-based bonuses. We offer generous paid time off. You get 26 Annual leaves and additional paid time off at the year-end (from 25th December to 1st January). We cover Term Insurance and Personal accidental insurance for you. Benefit from our free Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental and emotional wellbeing. You can also avail our Special Education Assistance Scheme to further develop your career. … And a lot more! All interns will receive a meaningful project and an unparalleled experience. We’ll provide the tools and resources you need to learn. The challenging and creative work you do throughout your internship will directly impact the team you are contributing to. All internships will be conducted in-person. Hosting managers will determine when and how often interns work in the office. All interns will have the option to opt into relocation services (flights, trains, or car mileage reimbursement). Additionally, all interns will be provided with a living stipend to subsidize housing, utility, commuting, and miscellaneous costs. Program Requirements Currently enrolled in a certificate, associate’s, bachelor’s, or master’s degree program and graduating May 2027 - June 2028 Available to participate in a 12-week internship starting in mid-May or mid-June Currently residing in the US or open to relocating oneself to the US Exhibits learning agility; has the ability to think differently, and/or grasp and apply new skills and concepts Approaches problems in a clear, well-organized, and solutions-oriented manner Works well with others and contributes to team tasks Able to effectively communicate problems, solutions, needs, or priorities Is engaged, seeks to learn, and is able to manage time effectively A passion for significantly impacting game development Applicants must apply with a resume and portfolio/reel to be considered Internship Opportunities VFX Intern: Join our world-class team bringing the iconic visuals of Call of Duty to life. As a VFX Intern, you’ll contribute to real-time effects that heighten gameplay—from explosive battlefield moments to immersive environmental details. You’ll collaborate with experienced artists and engineers to design dynamic, cinematic, and optimized visual effects using tools and in-game FX systems. This internship offers hands-on experience with AAA production pipelines, scripting multi-state FX objects, and balancing artistry with performance across next-gen platforms. You’ll gain a deep understanding of how visual effects shape player immersion and define the Call of Duty experience. Requirements: Experience creating real-time VFX simulations using Maya, 3ds Max, or in-game FX editors. Familiarity with Unreal, Unity, or proprietary game engines. Strong understanding of particle systems, shaders, dynamics, and 3D fundamentals. Experience with Houdini or Photoshop are a plus. A portfolio/reel that showcases real-time, photoreal visual effects is required Hosting Locations : High Moon Studios (Carlsbad, CA) & Treyarch (Playa Vista, CA) Our World At Activision, we strive to create the most iconic brands in gaming and entertainment. We’re driven by our mission to deliver unrivaled gaming experiences for the world to enjoy, together. We are home to some of the most beloved entertainment franchises including Call of Duty®, Crash Bandicoot™, Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™, and Guitar Hero®. As a leading worldwide developer, publisher and distributor of interactive entertainment and products, our “press start” is simple: delight hundreds of millions of players around the world with innovative, fun, thrilling, and engaging entertainment experiences. We’re not just looking back at our decades-long legacy; we’re forging ahead to keep advancing gameplay with some of the most popular titles and sophisticated technology in the world. We have bold ambitions to create the most inclusive company as we know our success comes from the passionate, creative, and diverse teams within our organization. We’re in the business of delivering fun and unforgettable entertainment for our player community to enjoy. And our future opportunities have never been greater — this could be your opportunity to level up. Ready to Activate Your Future? The video game industry and therefore our business is fast-paced and will continue to evolve. As such, the duties and responsibilities of this role may be changed as directed by the Company at any time to promote and support our business and relationships with industry partners. We love hearing from anyone who is enthusiastic about changing the games industry. Not sure you meet all qualifications? Let us decide! offers.description:
We are looking for a Senior VFX Artist to join our in-house art team working on a new mobile game . Bring your passion for gaming, VFX, and Tech Art. Learn continuously by interacting with our experienced team of Artists and Game Development specialists. We are enthusiastic about what we do, and we have fun doing it! Your mission Create high-quality real-time VFX for a 3D mobile game, including combat effects, abilities, impacts, environmental effects, transitions, UI effects, and reward moments. Build and improve art pipelines, tools, exporters, validation systems, and automation workflows. Develop , optimize, and maintain shaders and materials suitable for mobile performance constraints. Collaborate with engineers and artists on VFX pipelines, tools, performance profiling, and implementation workflows. Your skill set Expertise. You can showcase your professional experience (4+ years) based on an impressive portfolio. Knowledge . You have a solid understanding of graphics math and a willingness to keep learning and improving in this area. Coding . You are proficient in coding with C#, Python, HLSL, and CG Shader language or similar languages. 3D. You are experienced in modeling, skinning, and animation. Tools. You are skilled in using Houdini, Blender Geometry Nodes, or other comparable software. AI. You are willing to embrace new technologies and keen on AI-assisted production. Tech. You are proficient in using Unity3D. You understand technical constraints and are able to integrate your assets into the engine yourself. Team play. You are a proactive communicator, enjoy sharing knowledge, and are confidently interacting with an international/intercultural team of experts. Qualification. You have completed a university degree or comparable training in the field of graphics. English as company language. The game has a stylized, non-photorealistic look, built on custom outline and post-process shaders. Your job is to fit it into a tighter hardware budget than the PC version without losing that look. The work spans GPU profiling, content optimization, art style preservation, platform budgets, and editor tooling. Visual quality and readability come first, ahead of raw framerate. This is about measured trade-offs, not blanket cuts. You'll work with a team of Unreal engineers, technical artists, UX designers, QAs, and production. This is a content and GPU role, not a code role. Engine code, platform integration, CPU performance, and loading belong to engineering. This is a remote contract engagement, expected to run about 4 months. Preferred working hours are 8am-5pm US Central Time. European candidates should overlap with a minimum of 8am-12pm US Central Time. What to expect from the process: Profile Preselection: Our Talent Acquisition team will review your profile. Talent Acquisition Screening: Selected candidates will be contacted to undergo an initial interview to discuss their experience, skills, and fit for the role. Test: Qualified candidates will be invited to complete an assessment to demonstrate their abilities. Interviews: Finalists will participate in technical and cultural interviews to assess their proficiency and compatibility with our team. The quest (what you will do): Profile GPU cost and memory use with Unreal Insights, RenderDoc, and similar tools. Use profiling data to prioritize work. Verify that each change delivers a measurable gain without visible quality loss. Hand over non-art bottlenecks to engineering, with profiling data. Reduce shader cost, overdraw, draw calls, and texture memory. Tune Lumen, Nanite, and Virtual Shadow Maps for performance. Create LODs and simplify materials where global settings fall short. Protect the art style. Check every optimization against the original look: outlines, shading, post-process effects, lighting mood, and fog. Check how line work and fine detail hold up under cloud streaming. Adjust content where needed. Define content budgets and help engineering tune scalability settings. Build editor tools and validation checks to catch budget issues. Flag visual and performance risks early. Explain trade-offs to internal and external stakeholders. The skills (required qualifications): At least 4 years as a technical artist in games, including large or complex projects. At least 3 years of hands-on Unreal Engine 4 or 5 experience. Proven experience profiling and optimizing content in production games using GPU and memory profiling tools. Strong knowledge of materials, textures, LODs, lighting, VFX, and animation. Hands-on production experience with Lumen, Nanite, and Virtual Shadow Maps. Strong grasp of real-time rendering. This includes shader and material optimization, overdraw reduction, and texture memory management. Experience building Unreal editor tools or validation scripts. Experience with Perforce or a similar version control system. Comfortable explaining visual and performance trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders, in English, spoken and written. Nice to have: Experience optimizing stylized, non-photorealistic, or heavily post-processed visuals. Understanding of how cloud streaming and video encoding affect visual quality. Experience porting or downporting games to lower-spec hardware. Experience with Unreal Engine 5.5 or later. Experience working with outsourced teams and external development partners. Shipped at least one AAA or high-quality AA title. The reward: A fun and dynamic industry where you can make a difference. Professional

Creator-made content is already a proven part of EA's history — from community creation tools in Battlefield to The Gallery in The Sims 4. We believe new creative technologies and tools will expand how players engage with and contribute to our experiences, supported by thoughtful product design, safety systems, and global reach. Our focus is on enabling more players to participate in creative expression by making creation easier, safer, and more rewarding. Joining our Research & Engineering team as a Principal Technical Artist , you will operate at the crossroads of art and technology. In this role, you will work closely with Scientists, Engineers, and Designers to define the future of game world creation using advanced AI technologies. You will reimagine and implement how content is created, how worlds are built, and how experiences are made. Bridging the gap between research and development, you will help transform cutting-edge ideas into tangible proof of concepts and demonstrations. As a Principal Technical Artist you will have an extensive understanding of content pipelines, from source asset creation to final rendering, you excel at balancing visual quality with performance. You can implement novel solutions to complex art challenges. Furthermore, you keep pace with relevant research, understanding how technology must evolve to craft fantastic game worlds and visually-convincing experiences. This is a hybrid role, onsite three days a week in Montreal, Canada. You will report to our Senior Art Director. As a Principal Technical Artist , you will: Explore new frontiers and push beyond the current state of content creation pipelines and real-time visuals, for next-generation experiences, powered by AI. Work with other developers to design novel technologies that bring game worlds to life, including developing new approaches to enable art for game worlds at scale, quality, and for anyone to create. Bring new ideas, discuss, and implement solutions to some of the most complex video game content creation challenges to create differentiation for EA. Collaborate with other developers where your expertise will improve the visual quality of the work of everyone. Participate in team efforts to create demos that showcase our work in its best light. Partner closely with Art Direction to translate creative goals into practical technical solutions while preserving the intended visual quality and style. Develop tools and workflows that help everyone to make art, iterate faster and make Neural Rendering technologies more controllable and useful. offers.title: VFX Artist
offers.description: We're looking for a FX Artist to craft believable, high-fidelity real-time effects for a visually grounded game. You'll be responsible for the explosions, fire, smoke, fluids, weather, environmental ambiance, weapon and impact effects, and gameplay-critical readability that make our world feel physical and alive. You'll work closely with art, design, and engineering to push realism while hitting performance and clarity targets. Example of responsibilities Create and own high-quality real-time visual effects: fire, smoke, explosions, debris, fluids, atmospherics, weather, and surface/impact responses, grounded in real-world reference. Build effects that balance visual fidelity, gameplay readability, and runtime performance across target platforms. Author shaders and materials for FX, and collaborate with tech artists/engineers on simulation, lighting integration, and optimization. Develop and maintain reusable VFX systems, tools, and libraries to scale quality across the team. Partner with design and animation to ensure effects communicate gameplay clearly (telegraphs, hit feedback, state changes). Profile and optimize effects (overdraw, particle counts, draw calls, GPU cost) and debug issues across the pipeline. Contribute to look development, references, and visual targets alongside the Art Director and VFX Lead. It would be awesome if you have 5+ years of professional VFX experience in games, with at least one shipped title (or comparable production work). Strong real-time VFX skills in a modern engine; Unreal Engine (Niagara) and/or Unity (VFX Graph/Shuriken). Solid understanding of the physics and behavior behind realistic effects Proficiency with node-based shaders/materials and a good grasp of real-time lighting and rendering. Experience authoring textures and simulations using tools such as Houdini, EmberGen, Substance, or similar. A strong artistic eye, timing, silhouette, color, composition, and motion. Performance-minded: comfortable profiling and optimizing for frame budgets. Strong communication and collaboration skills across art, design, and engineering. Nice to have Houdini for VFX simulation and tool/HDA creation. Experience with fluid/destruction systems (e.g., Chaos, FLIP/Pyro). Scripting (Python, Blueprint, or similar) for tooling and automation. Background in film/VFX or a strong traditional art/photography foundation. At Embark we offer competitive salaries, a generous profit-sharing program, and much more, but most of all we invite you to take part of a journey into the unknown, to build creative, surprising and beautiful experiences together. We welcome people from all backgrounds and are looking forward to reading more about you (in English)!

offers.title: Technical Artist | Remote
offers.description: About the Role We are working with a well-backed technology startup. They are building an innovative platform designed to democratize 3D content creation. We are searching for an experienced Technical Artist to bridge the gap between complex algorithmic workflows and intuitive user experiences for digital creators. In this role, you will take ownership of sophisticated pipelines and ensure high-fidelity outputs for real-time applications. Key Responsibilities Design and maintain advanced procedural content generation pipelines for automated environment building. Integrate complex computational workflows and layout generation systems into browser-compatible real-time engines. Develop robust tooling and asset pipelines that scale automated outputs into high-quality, production-ready 3D geometry. Establish strict visual and performance benchmarks for generated 3D assets across materials, topology, and animation. Prototype emerging rendering technologies and spatial representation techniques to evaluate product viability. Collaborate with engineering teams to define technical art direction, ensuring all content remains visually cohesive and performant. Required Qualifications 5+ years of experience operating as a Technical Artist, Technical Art Director, or in a similar pipeline-heavy role. Extensive, hands-on expertise with procedural content generation software. Proven working knowledge of modern real-time 3D engines and rendering environments. A demonstrated history of integrating advanced computational or procedural techniques into standard art production pipelines. Exceptional understanding of core 3D asset creation, optimization, and shading principles. Strong scripting abilities and the capacity to build proprietary tools while acting as a liaison between creative and engineering departments.

offers.title: Lead Technical Artist (On-site only)
offers.description: Gray Zone Warfare has been under development in our bustling offices for three years. This new game is an immersive tactical FPS with a maximum focus on realism , engaging gameplay, and stunning graphics powered by Unreal Engine 5. At MADFINGER, we have always strived to create incredible, world-class gaming experience , as players of our previous titles will attest. Moving forward, we remain dedicated to this vision and are determined to continue setting new standards in the gaming industry. We're looking for a Lead Technical Artist to join us in this pursuit of excellence and guide our talented team to new heights. If you are a visionary technical artist who thrives on solving complex challenges and elevating artistic performance, we would love to see you lead and mentor our team. This is an on-site position in Brno, Czech Republic. WHAT IS YOUR MISSION? Lead and mentor a team of technical artists, serving as the primary bridge between the art and programming departments. Oversee and guide the creation of technical art solutions, balancing visual quality, performance, and efficiency across the entire project. Work closely with the Art Director and project leads to establish and maintain a high artistic and technical standard. Develop and optimize workflows, tools, and pipelines to support the entire art team, from environment design to VFX. Master Unreal Engine's technical capabilities, leading innovations to push the boundaries of what's possible in real-time graphics. Troubleshoot complex technical challenges, providing strategic solutions to remove blockers and maintain high performance. Collaborate with engineers and artists to optimize game performance. WHO WILL FIT WITH US: Minimum 5 years of experience in a Senior Technical Artist role. Extensive hands-on experience with Unreal Engine 5, with at least one full game production cycle as a Senior or Lead Technical Artist. Deep understanding of performance optimization techniques, particularly in high-end real-time graphics. Experience with procedural content generation, VFX, lighting, and shader creation. Strong knowledge of industry-standard tools. Strong leadership capabilities, with proven experience in leading. Mastery of the Unreal Engine art pipeline, materials, and shaders. Passion for pushing Unreal Engine to its limits to achieve groundbreaking visual quality. Deep understanding of PBR workflows and advanced material editor practices. As this position is based in Brno, you must be open to relocation. We offer relocation support to help make the transition smooth. You are eligible to work in the Czech Republic. Due to a lengthy visa process, we are not able to offer visa sponsorship. WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU: A dream team, of course. Full of gaming enthusiasts 😊 A modern gaming office - a space not only for work but also for relaxation and socializing in our Relax room. Transparent working environment with open communication. Benefits package - 5 weeks of vacation, flexible working hours, a lump sum for meal vouchers, on-site gym, and sponsored massages, Czech/English lessons in the office. Sabbatical leave after seven years working for the company. Employee referral program. An opportunity to meet the other colleagues not only at work but also at various social and teambuilding events in and out of the office. Relocation package for EU foreigners. WANT TO FIND OUR MORE? offers.title: VFX Artist Reviewer
offers.description: About the Role We are seeking a skilled VFX Artist / Reviewer on a freelance basis. In this role, you will be responsible for reviewing and approving real-time visual effects created by external vendors to ensure they meet our artistic vision, technical requirements, and project standards. You will provide clear, constructive feedback to guide revisions, maintain stylistic consistency, and oversee successful implementation into the game engine. This position requires a strong eye for timing, motion, readability, and visual impact, as well as technical proficiency and the ability to communicate effectively with distributed teams. Responsibilities and Duties Review real-time VFX assets (environmental effects, combat FX, character abilities, particle systems, shaders, and cinematic VFX) delivered by external vendors for visual quality, timing, performance, and technical accuracy. Provide actionable, detailed feedback to vendors to ensure adherence to project style guides, gameplay readability needs, and technical specifications. Integrate approved VFX into the game engine, ensuring correct setup, performance optimization, and compatibility with gameplay or cinematic requirements. Collaborate closely with internal VFX leads, technical artists, designers, and production teams to maintain pipeline efficiency. Identify and troubleshoot visual, technical, or performance-related issues in VFX assets. Maintain documentation and communicate best practices for VFX production, optimization, and review workflows. Minimum Qualifications 2+ years of experience in a VFX reviewer, in-engine VFX artist, or outsourcing management role. At least one shipped title (console, PC, or equivalent). Strong understanding of VFX principles: timing, motion, impact, gameplay readability, stylization, and environmental storytelling. Proficient with Unreal Engine or a comparable real-time engine (particle systems, Niagara, shader authoring, etc.). Experienced in industry-standard tools such as Houdini, Maya/Blender, Substance tools, Photoshop, and real-time VFX authoring workflows. Excellent communication and feedback delivery skills. Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain consistency across multiple visual effects styles and environments. Preferred Qualifications Prior experience managing or reviewing outsourced VFX teams . Familiarity with procedural workflows , particle systems, and real-time optimization techniques. Experience with version control tools such as Perforce or Git . Understanding of performance budgets , shader complexity, and memory constraints for large-scale or FX-heavy environments. Why Join Us? At Lakshya Digital, you'll work on high-quality projects alongside a passionate, global team of artists and developers. Your expertise will directly contribute to crafting impactful, immersive visual effects that enhance player experience worldwide. Benefits Lakshya is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment and selection process and work environment. Please inform us of any accommodations required to ensure you have access to a fair and equitable process. Role Information Studio: Lakshya Area of Work: Art Service: Create Employment Type: Freelance Working Pattern: Remote

offers.description: Description GameSim is a game development studio that partners with clients to build games across PC/console and a range of art styles. We are proactively building a pipeline of qualified candidates in anticipation of potential hiring needs over the coming months. Applications will be reviewed and retained for future consideration as opportunities arise. We are looking for a VFX Artist with strong real-time effects skills, solid technical judgment, and the potential to grow into broader lead responsibilities over time. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys creating high-quality visual effects while also helping teams stay aligned, organized, and efficient. Depending on the project, this person may contribute directly to hands-on VFX production, in-engine implementation, feedback, task breakdowns, optimization, workflow documentation, and cross-discipline collaboration. Because our projects can vary widely in style, scope, platform, and client needs, we are looking for an adaptable VFX artist with strong fundamentals, a practical production mindset, and the ability to translate creative or design direction into clear, executable effects work. This role offers flexible work options, including remote, hybrid or in-office arrangements. offers.description:
Cofrico. Instalaciones de Refrigeración y Climatización Industrial y Comercial | Técnico/a Frigorista Industrial – Especialista en NH₃ (Amoníaco) Ofertas Trabaja en COFRICO y GRADHOC Ofertas Trabaja en COFRICO y GRADHOC Web Web Técnico/a Frigorista Industrial – Especialista en NH₃ (Amoníaco) OPERACIONES - COFRICO ·                                             Vigo Inscribirme Perfil Técnico Frigorista - Oficial 1º Localización Vigo, Pontevedra, España Experiencia 5

                                                                                            Años de Experiencia Descripción Técnico/a Frigorista Industrial – Especialista en NH₃ (Amoníaco) 📍 Vigo y alrededores | Contrato estable ¿Quiénes somos? En Cofrico somos especialistas en el diseño, instalación y mantenimiento de sistemas de refrigeración industrial, comercial y climatización, con una sólida trayectoria en el desarrollo de soluciones basadas en refrigerantes naturales como el amoníaco (NH₃) y el CO₂ . Trabajamos en proyectos de frío industrial de gran envergadura para sectores como la industria alimentaria, pesquera y logística frigorífica , con instalaciones que incluyen centrales frigoríficas de NH₃, sistemas en cascada NH₃/CO₂, plantas enfriadoras, túneles de congelación, cámaras frigoríficas industriales y sistemas de refrigeración de procesos productivos. Apostamos por la innovación, la eficiencia energética y la sostenibilidad, incorporando tecnologías avanzadas como Gradhoc , nuestra solución de monitorización y optimización energética, que nos permite mejorar el rendimiento de las instalaciones y avanzar hacia un mantenimiento predictivo. ¿A quién buscamos? Queremos incorporar a nuestro equipo de Vigo un/a Técnico/a Frigorista Industrial con experiencia en instalaciones de amoníaco (NH₃) , que disfrute del trabajo técnico, la resolución de averías y los retos que plantean las instalaciones frigoríficas industriales. Buscamos una persona con autonomía, capacidad de diagnóstico y compromiso con la seguridad y la calidad del servicio, que quiera seguir desarrollándose en una empresa especializada en refrigeración industrial. ¿Qué harás en tu día a día? Realizar el mantenimiento preventivo y correctivo de instalaciones frigoríficas industriales , principalmente con refrigerante NH₃. Diagnosticar y resolver averías mecánicas, eléctricas y de funcionamiento en centrales frigoríficas y equipos industriales. Intervenir en instalaciones con compresores industriales, evaporadores, condensadores, bombas, válvulas y sistemas de regulación y control. Supervisar el funcionamiento de las instalaciones, verificando parámetros de operación, rendimiento y condiciones de seguridad. Realizar ajustes y actuaciones técnicas para garantizar la fiabilidad, continuidad operativa y eficiencia energética de los sistemas. Colaborar con el equipo técnico en la identificación de mejoras y optimización de las instalaciones. ¿Qué te ofrecemos? Estabilidad laboral: contrato indefinido y un proyecto profesional a largo plazo. Especialización y desarrollo profesional: trabajarás con instalaciones de frío industrial y tecnologías de refrigeración con refrigerantes naturales, punteras a nivel nacional. Formación continua: contarás con el apoyo de nuestro equipo de soporte técnico SAT, formado por profesionales con amplia experiencia en instalaciones frigoríficas industriales. Horario de lunes a viernes , de 08:00 a 17:30 hrs. Furgoneta de empresa para los desplazamientos laborales. Media dieta diaria y dieta completa, cuando sean necesarias por desplazamientos. Requisitos ¿Qué buscamos en ti? Experiencia previa en mantenimiento de instalaciones de refrigeración industrial con amoníaco (NH₃). Este es el requisito principal de la posición. Conocimientos sólidos de sistemas frigoríficos industriales y sus componentes. Capacidad para diagnosticar averías y trabajar de forma autónoma en instalaciones industriales. Valoraremos especialmente: Experiencia con compresores de tornillo y alternativos, sistemas de NH₃ bombeado, circuitos de glicol y sistemas en cascada NH₃/CO₂. Experiencia en instalaciones frigoríficas de la industria alimentaria, pesquera o logística. Titulación de Técnico Superior en mantenimiento de Instalaciones Térmicas y de Fluidos, ó Técnico en Montaje y Mantenimiento de Instalaciones de Frío,

offers.title: Senior Full Stack
offers.description: Headquarters: Tallinn, Estonia URL: https://toggl.com/jobs/ We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join one of our Product Tribes, the cross-functional units that own the end-to-end experience for a specific Toggl user role. You'll join the Tribe building for managers, the people who plan work, protect margins, and keep projects on time and on budget. You own significant parts of that experience end-to-end, working hands-on with product and design to ship work that matters. You'll do this as we build and launch Toggl 2.0, our consolidated planning, time tracking, and time intelligence product. The salary for this position is €83,000 annually. You can work from anywhere in the world as long as your main location is between UTC-4 and UTC+4. The Role As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you own meaningful parts of the product end-to-end, from the data model and the API to the interface someone actually clicks: the technical approach, the quality of what ships, and whether it actually works for the people using it. You are accountable not for tickets closed, but for clarity, craft, and outcomes. You'll work in the Tribe serving managers, across planning and capacity management, dashboards, and billable work. This is some of the most data-dense, interaction-heavy surface area in the product: schedules and capacity views, reports, and visualizations that have to stay fast and readable at real customer scale. The interesting problems live on both sides of the API here - the query behind a capacity view matters as much as how that view renders. You'll build with React and TypeScript on the frontend and our backend services (mostly Golang) and data layer (Postgres) behind them, alongside a product manager, a designer, and engineers who are used to owning their work and pushing back when something isn't right. In a tribe of 5 other engineers, your impact and visibility are high. Our team meetings are scheduled between 11:00 and 16:00 UTC. Your availability and commitment to participate in these sessions are essential for effective collaboration and team alignment. Your main responsibilities will be: Ownership and delivery Take projects from problem to production. Own the technical approach for major features front to back, break the work down sensibly, sequence it, and ship in slices rather than one big drop. Make the technical calls in your area. Choose between options, name the tradeoffs, and decide without waiting for permission or escalating routine judgment. Keep your work visible without being chased. Flag risks and slips early, keep the Tribe in the loop, and unblock yourself. Craft and quality across the stack Build interfaces people trust with dense, real-world data. Planning views, dashboards, and reports that stay fast, accessible, and readable when the dataset gets ugly. Design the data and API layer those views depend on. Model it so the feature you're building now doesn't make the next three harder. Own performance as a feature, end to end. Profile, measure, and fix the slow query and the slow render instead of hoping the data stays small. Write code others can work in. Sensible components and services, real test coverage where it earns its keep, and a codebase that's easier to change after you touch it. Working with product and design Shape solutions, don't just implement them. Push on the problem, question requirements that don't hold up, and propose simpler paths when you see one. Partner closely with design. Prototype early, spot the edge cases in a flow before it's built, and hold the bar on UX quality with your designer rather than after handoff. Stay close to users and evidence. Join user tests, read the feedback, look at the data, and let it change what you build. Raising the bar Review code with intent. Give precise, actionable feedback that makes the change and the person better. Mentor and interview. Help other engineers grow, and help us hire well. Improve things across team boundaries. Spot shared components and duplicated work between Tribes, and raise it before we build the same thing twice. AI as core leverage Use AI tools extensively in your daily work for exploration, prototyping, code generation and review, debugging, research, and writing. AI fluency is not optional. It's part of how you increase your speed, depth, and impact - and you're expected to help the rest of the Tribe get better at it too. About You You will thrive in this role if you: Have significant experience building and shipping production web applications end to end, and can lead major projects rather than just contribute to them. Are genuinely comfortable on both sides of the stack. You're deep on one side and properly capable on the other, not someone who hands off at the API boundary. Have deep, practical knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and modern CSS - including state management and side-effect handling in large applications. Are solid on backend fundamentals: at least one backend language you know well, API design, relational data modelling, and enough instinct for query performance to spot the problem before production does. Prior Golang experience is not mandatory but you have to be willing to adopt it and become comfortable with it fast. Hold an extremely high bar for quality. You know what great looks like, you notice the details others miss, and you don't ship work you wouldn't put your name on. Have a knack for data-heavy product surfaces - performance, readability, and the principles behind a chart that actually communicates something. Care about the user's problem, not just the ticket. You start from what someone is trying to get done and work back to the implementation. Own outcomes, not output. You follow your work into production, watch how it behaves, and fix what needs fixing. Thrive in ambiguity and move fast. You make confident decisions with incomplete information, adapt when things change, and course-correct without drama. Are hands-on with AI tools. You actively use AI as a core part of how you build, not a side experiment, and you have opinions about where it helps and where it doesn't. Don't need to be managed. You set your own direction, keep people in the loop, and ask for help when it matters. Have excellent written and verbal English communication skills. You write clearly, explain technical tradeoffs to non-engineers without jargon, and default to async communication that others can follow. Are eager to contribute to the engineering team's growth - code review, mentoring, and interviewing included. Value transparency, ownership, and speed over perfection. You ship, learn, and improve rather than waiting for the perfect plan. Nice to have: Experience with TanStack is a bonus, and so is a real understanding of frontend caching and eventual consistency, we'd love to hire someone who's dealt with that tradeoff directly. Experience with capacity planning, scheduling, reporting, or other complex B2B SaaS products. Experience working with distributed or microservice systems, a basic understanding of infrastructure and infrastructure as code, and some experience creating, improving, or debugging CI/CD pipelines. This Role Is NOT A ticket-taker role. If you want fully specced work handed to you, this isn't the right fit. A pixel-pusher translating finished designs into code with no say in the problem or the solution. A role where you hand off at the API boundary. If "that's a backend ticket" is your instinct, this will frustrate you. A role where quality is someone else's job. Toggl doesn't have a dedicated QA team or layer: there's no separate team that will catch your bugs, write your tests, or own your performance regressions. A place to work in isolation from users. You'll be expected to know who you're building for and why. A role for people who need heavy process, frequent approvals, or top-down direction to do their best work. The Team We are a global team of ~80 awesome people working from over 40 countries around the globe. We hire globally, you work locally—in the heart of London, a beach outside of Río de Janeiro, or a quiet village near Florence, the choice is yours. Every few months we travel to meet up somewhere in the world and spend some quality time together. We place a huge amount of trust in our people, and we measure the outcomes rather than the work itself. Our values fuel our results. What's Happening at Toggl Toggl is at an exciting turning point. We're taking our best-in-class time tracking - trusted and loved by millions of users worldwide - and expanding it into something bigger: Toggl 2.0 . One product that brings together time tracking, planning, capacity management, reporting, and insight. The idea is simple: better time tracking creates better data, which powers everything else. We call it time intelligence. We build with AI throughout, and we think it's a real multiplier for strong engineers rather than a substitute for them. The judgment, the tradeoffs, and the accountability for what ships stay with people. Benefits Freedom to choose when and how much you work—we only measure results 24 days of paid time off a year, plus your local holidays Unlimited sick leave In-person meetups for team-building (expenses covered) 4-6 weeks paid sabbatical (depending on tenure) Laptop budget up to 2,500€ and it renews every 3 years €2,000 budget to set up your home office and an additional €300 every year after 3 years of tenure €3,000 per year for co-working space membership and/or internet service at home €4,000 per year contribution to use for training, workshops, and conferences €2,400 per year contribution for any equipment or services to improve and/or maintain your physical and mental health Support for buying tools you need for doing your best work (even eyeglasses if you need a new pair) To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toggl-senior-full-stack

offers.title: Graphics AI Software Engineer
offers.description: 🚀 We’re Growing Our Research and Innovation Dream Team! Titles? Meh, we’re not big on them, but let’s call this one Graphics AI Software Engineer 😉 As part of our international research squad, you’ll craft tailor-made solutions that wow our clients. We’re hunting for a passionate Graphics AI Soft Engineer with a solid technical background. Your mission? Train, deploy, and put groundbreaking developments into action — and that’s just the beginning. Here’s the deal: Collaborate with both research and applied engineering teams on multiple projects. Your work will involve exploring, designing, and implementing advanced AI solutions focused on computer vision, 3D rendering, and spatial computing. This role is integral to our mission of developing innovative technologies that redefine how AI enhances and interacts with 3D environments . AGILE isn’t just a buzzword here — it’s how we roll. Multidisciplinary teams? Check. Full ownership of projects? Double check. Ready to take on projects that matter, with a team that’s as passionate as you are? Let’s make it happen! 😊 You will be responsible for: Design and Implement AI-Powered 3D Graphics Solutions Develop and deploy advanced AI techniques within Desktop, Web, VR, and AR applications using our proprietary Evergine graphics engine. Your work will harness the power of AI to push the boundaries of 3D graphics performance, realism, and interactivity. Pioneer and Integrate Advanced AI Models for Computer Vision and Spatial Computing : Leverage and go beyond existing models—such as NeRF, Gaussian Splatting, Point Cloud processing techniques, SAMv2, and GroundingDINO or FlorenceV2 —to not only elevate 3D applications but also create novel, next-generation AI models that drive the future of dynamic, responsive, and intelligent 3D environments. Drive AI Innovation in Architectural Design: Lead the architectural vision for AI-driven 3D applications, playing a critical role in designing and integrating both established and newly developed machine learning, deep learning, and computer vision frameworks to achieve groundbreaking results. Develop and Scale Custom AI Solutions for Complex 3D Applications : Design original algorithms and optimize existing machine learning models for performance and scalability, enabling realistic and seamless interactions in sophisticated 3D spaces and simulations. Collaborate in an AGILE, AI-Innovation Environment: Join a multidisciplinary team focused on AGILE methodologies, where you’ll work closely with experts in AI and 3D technology, driving research and development to achieve efficient, transformative outcomes. Requirements Critical Thinking and Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to approach challenges thoughtfully and analytically, with an eagerness to learn through problem-solving. Interest in 3D Engines and Graphics Development: While prior experience with 3D engines like Unity or Unreal is a plus, a strong motivation to learn and apply these tools to create AI-enhanced interactive graphics is what truly matters. Basic Understanding of AI and Machine Learning in 3D Applications: Familiarity with concepts like machine learning, deep learning, or computer vision**, with an enthusiasm for learning how they can enhance 3D environments (e.g., NeRF , Point Cloud techniques ). Collaborative and Growth-Oriented Mindset: A strong willingness to learn, grow, and contribute within a collaborative and supportive team environment. Commitment to Ongoing Learning and Innovation: A genuine curiosity for advancements in AI and 3D technology , paired with the motivation to grow your expertise over time. Willingness to Learn AI Tools and Frameworks: Exposure to PyTorch , TensorFlow , or similar frameworks is beneficial, but the drive to gain practical experience with these tools is what’s most important. Skills to Help You Excel: Proficiency in Python and C# Fundamentals: Basic experience with Python for AI development and C# for graphics programming, with an openness to expanding knowledge in both. Understanding of 3D Graphics and Mathematics: Familiarity with key 3D concepts (e.g., vectors , matrices , coordinate systems ) and a desire to explore their real-world applications. Interest in Prototyping and Software Development: Comfort with trying out ideas through rapid prototyping and embracing disciplined software development practices. Curiosity About Cloud Platforms for AI Deployment: I nterest in learning about cloud platforms like Azure , AWS , or GCP , and their potential for scalable AI solutions, including MLOps practices (model deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management). Basic Proficiency in English: Ability to engage effectively in discussions with an international, English-speaking team Benefits Salary determined by the market and your experience 🤑 Flexible schedule 35 Hours / Week 😎 Fully remote work (optional) 🌍 Flexible compensation (restaurant, transport, and childcare) ✌ Medical and dental insurance (completely free of charge for the employee) 🚑 Individual budget for training or equipment and free Microsoft certifications 📚 English lessons 🗽 Birthday day off 🌴🥳 Monthly bonus for electricity and Internet expenses at home 💻 Discount on gym plan and sports activities 🔝 Plain Camp (annual team-building event) 🎪 Extra perks: events attendance and speakers, welcome pack, baby basket, Christmas basket, discount portal for employees ➕ The pleasure of always working with the latest technological tools! Will you let us know you better? The selection process: Simple Phone screen 1st interview (adding presentation of a case study to be carried out) Team interview to meet colleagues Final interview with management (also to talk and review the case study) What is Plain Concepts? Plain Concepts is a global company of over 500 people passionate about technology and innovation. Since our founding, we have grown through technical proficiency and confidence in ideas that others might consider risky, creating custom solutions for our clients. With offices in more than 6 countries, our mission is to continue to drive cutting-edge projects around the world. We are highly committed to technical excellence. We are known for developing highly customized projects, offering specialized technical consultancy and training. Thanks to the great work of our technicians, we have been recognized for our ability to lead innovative projects that generate value, from artificial intelligence to blockchain, driving solutions that help companies optimize their performance. What we do at Plain Concepts? We pride ourselves on being a 100% technical team, dedicated to crafting custom projects from scratch, offering expert technical consultancy, and providing top-tier training. Our approach goes beyond traditional outsourcing; we focus on creating value together with our clients. Our teams are diverse and multidisciplinary, operating in a flat, collaborative structure. We live and breathe AGILE principles, ensuring flexibility and efficiency in everything we do. Knowledge-sharing is at our core: from supporting each other internally to contributing to the broader tech community through conferences, events, and talks. Innovation drives us — even the boldest ideas are welcome here. Transparency underpins all our relationships, fostering trust and long-term partnerships. Want to learn more? Check out our website! ➡ plainconcepts.com At Plain Concepts, we certainly seek to provide equal opportunities. We want diverse applicants regardless of race, colour, gender, religion, national origin, citizenship, disability, age, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law.

offers.title: Full Stack Developer (Python, React)
offers.description: We currently have a vacancy for a Full Stack developer fluent in English, to offer his/her services as an expert remotely (within EU) . In the context of the first assignment, the successful candidate will be integrated in the Development team of the company that will closely cooperate with a major client’s IT team. Your tasks: Designing and developing tools to interact with social media platforms and facilitate data collection workflows; Creating user-friendly front-end interfaces for data annotation and analysis purposes using modern frameworks and technologies; Developing back-end APIs and services to store, manage, and process data, and integrate with data analysis tools and pipelines; Writing scripts to automate tasks and workflows, using languages such as Bash and Python; Configuring and maintaining Linux-based systems for development and testing environments Ensuring the scalability, security, and performance of the tools using automation and monitoring tools; Providing technical support, troubleshooting, and maintenance for all developed tools. Requirements Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field. with relevant IT professional experience of at least 7 years; Minimum 3 years of experience in automation and scripting using languages such as Bash and Python to streamline development workflows and system administration tasks.Experience in Python, JavaScript, and web development technologies (HTML/CSS); Minimum 3 years of professional experience in full-stack web development, including designing and developing tools and applications; Minimum 3 years of experience in designing and implementing front-end interfaces using modern frameworks (such as React) and web technologies (HTML/CSS, JavaScript); Minimum 3 years of experience in developing back-end APIs and services using frameworks such as Flask, including database design and integration; Minimum 3 years of experience in database management systems, including both relational databases (e.g., MySQL) and NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB); Minimum 3 years of experience in Linux system administration, including user management, networking, security, and system configuration; Minimum 3 years of experience with containerization technologies (such as Docker) and orchestration tools (such as Kubernetes); Minimum 3 years of experience with agile development methodologies, version control systems (such as Git), and project tracking tools. Experience with automation and scripting using Bash and Python for task and workflow optimisation; Experience with agile development methodologies and version control systems such as Git; Experience with project management software such as JIRA and Microsoft Project; Experience with collaboration platforms such as Confluence and SharePoint; Knowledge of reporting methods; Certifications in web development, front-end or back-end frameworks (e.g., React, Flask, or equivalent platforms), cloud computing platforms (such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud), containerization and orchestration technologies (such as Docker, Kubernetes, or equivalent platforms), database management systems, software engineering, DevOps, or related fields will be an asset. Excellent command of the English language. Benefits If you are seeking a career in an exciting and dynamic company, where you will offer your services as part of a team of a major European Institution, operating in an international, multilingual and multicultural environment where you can expect real chances to make a difference, please send us your detailed CV in English, quoting reference: (20648/10/2026) We offer a competitive remuneration (either on contract basis or remuneration with full benefits package), based on qualifications and experience. All applications will be treated as confidential. You may also consider all our other open vacancies by visiting the career section of our web site ( www.eurodyn.com) and follow us on Twitter (@EURODYN_Careers) and LinkedIn. EUROPEAN DYNAMICS ( www.eurodyn.com ) is a leading Software, Information and Communication Technologies company, operating internationally (Athens, Brussels, Luxembourg, Copenhagen, Stockholm, London, Nicosia, Hong-Kong, Valetta, etc). The company employs over 1000 engineers, IT experts and consultants (around 3% PhD, 36% MSc and 53% BSc or equivalent). We design and develop software applications using state-of-the-art technology. The group generates annual revenues in the range of EURO 40 million, with an EBITDA in the range of 20%. The value of our contract portfolio exceeds EURO 300 million. EUROPEAN DYNAMICS is a renowned supplier of IT services to government institutions, multinational corporations, public administrations and multinational companies, research and academic institutes. courses.title: Técnico de soporte certificado en redes CISCO
courses.description: Metodoloxía Virtual + teleformación Tipo de actividade Curso Tipo de edición Edición única (desempregados/as e ocupados/as) Data inicio 26/11/2026 Data fin 21/12/2026 Certificación Sí Examen certificación Cisco Certified Support Technician (CCST) Networking - (100-150 CCST Networking) Exam Data prueba selección 10/11/2026 19:30:00 Criterio de selección Proba técnica presencial no CNTG en Santiago de Compostela Período de rexistro 24/10/2026 - 08/11/2026 Matrícula Gratuíta Horario Virtual: 26 e 30 de novembro; 1, 3, 9, 10, 14, 15, 17 e 21 de decembro;  de 16:30 a 20:30 horas Teleformación: do 27 de novembro ao 18 de decembro de 16:30 a 21:30 horas (horario de referencia) Número de prazas 20 Número de inscritos 16 Tecnoloxías Cisco Inscribirme Ficha Técnico de soporte certificado en redes CISCO Datos xerais Temario Descrición O curso oficial Cisco Certified Support Technician Networking enmárcase no currículo de cursos oficiais do programa Cisco Networking Academy, e os seus contados supoñen unha vía de entrada para o desenvolvemento de habilidades profesionais fundamentais na área de Networking. O curso trata de fundamentos das comunicación en rede, os servizos de asignación de dirección, os aspectos precisos para o dimensionamento da rede, a construción e cableado dunha rede, e a configuración de seguridade básica da mesma. A formación ten unha duración de 70 horas (40 AULA VIRTUAL SINCRONA - 30 TELEFORMACIÓN). HORARIO: Virtual : luns, martes e jxoves de 16:30 a 20:30 horas Teleformación: mércores e venres de 16:30 a 21:30 horas (horario de referencia) Obxectivos Dotar ao alumnado dunha formación e certificación de nivel básico, que o habilita para desenvolver roles de nivel básico como Técnico de Soporte de Rede, Soporte Técnico de nivel básico ou Especialista de Soporte de TI. Dirigido a O curso está dirixido a todos/as aqueles/as profesionais de TI que desexen iniciarse no ámbito das redes informáticas ou precisen reforzar e/ou actualizar os fundamentos da comunicación neste ámbito, consolidando coñecementos con orientación á prestación de servizos de soporte a redes básicas de servizos de resolución de problemas. Para un mellor aproveitamento do curso, é recomendable dispoñer de competencias introdutorias en redes e/ou sistemas operativos -Windows, Linux e/ou dispositivos móbiles-. Perfil do docente Os docentes son instrutores acreditados polo programa Cisco Netacad e certificados nas especialidades que imparten. Temario Conceptos básicos de redes Dispositivos de rede e configuración inicial Direccionamento de rede e resolución de problemas básicos Soporte e seguridad de rede. Horas 70 Beneficios Opción gratuita dun exame de certificación oficial Diploma de asistencia Data fin renuncia 17/11/2026 Data inicio inscripción 24/10/2026 Data fin inscripción 08/11/2026 Horas distancia 40 Horas presenciales 0 Horas teleformación 30 Máximo horas de ausencia 10 horas e 12 minutos Módulos Módulo igualdade (10 horas) Plazo abierto Sí
